description: NaGa(SiO₃)₂ is Esseneite structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.84 Å. Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.12 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ga, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaGa₂Si tetrahedra.
